title: Protocol Decoder
text: Decode a uint8 byte stream by specifying the packet structure, 2 inputs, 5 outputs, {Terminator} sets Terminator of the; {Parse comma separated variables} sets the parse input data that contains comma separated variables, {Header}, {Field name} sets the name of the field in the packet structure, {Output field length} sets the length of the field in the packet structure as per the data, {Output field data type} sets the data type, {Byte order} sets the endianess of the field in the packet Little, {Specify maximum length if last field has variable size} enables last field to output variable-size data and specify maximum length of the field numeric, {Specify logic for checksum validation} enables the logic for checksum validation and select the logic XOR, {Checksum size} sets the number of bytes of checksum data numeric, {File path} sets the path of the function, {Custom terminator} and {Is input data stream length available} enables additional input for data stream. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Parse comma separated variables
params.values: Parse input data that contains comma separated variables array

params.name: Header
params.values: Header of the packet character array | array of numeric values less than 255

params.name: Field name
params.values: Name of the field in the packet structure Field1 (default) | string

params.name: Output field length
params.values: Length of the field in the packet structure as per the data type 1 (default) | numeric scalar

params.name: Output field data type
params.values: Data type of the field uint8 (default) | int8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | int64 | uint64 | single | double

params.name: Byte order
params.values: Endianess of the field in the packet Little endian (default) | Big endian

params.name: Specify maximum length if last field has variable size
params.values: Enable last field to output variable-size data and specify maximum length of the field numeric scalar

params.name: Specify logic for checksum validation
params.values: Enable the logic for checksum validation and select the logic XOR of bytes | 2’s complement of sum of bytes | Custom algorithm

params.name: Checksum size
params.values: Number of bytes of checksum data numeric scalar

params.name: File path
params.values: Path of the function (.m) used for custom checksum logic MATLAB ® path

params.name: Terminator
params.values: Terminator of the packet (default) | CR (’\r’) | LF (’\n’) | CR/LF (’\r\n’) | NULL (’\0’) | Custom Terminator

params.name: Custom terminator
params.values: Custom terminator of the packet character array

params.name: Is input data stream length available
params.values: Enable additional input for data stream length off (default) | on
